hints.title: Word Boundary Counting
hints.text: In valid sentences separated by single spaces, the number of words is one plus the count of spaces.

hints.title: Sentence Traversal
hints.text: Inspect each sentence and determine its word count by counting spaces.

hints.title: Maximum Tracking
hints.text: Maintain and return the maximum word count encountered.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N * L) single pass space counting
complexity.notes: Word count equals space count plus one.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Splitting every sentence into arrays allocates unnecessary string objects.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting space characters directly avoids heap allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that words equal space count plus one in clean sentences.
